subject: PEER HANDOFF: current-main terminal NATIVE_COVER stale reassert remains reachable; two-layer fence candidate
body: FINAL_MAIN_SHA=699ed29288ab2aa24463902fcefe752d432717d2. FIELD+SOURCE CONFIRMED: field close-cycle 10 reaches terminal NATIVE_COVER generation 83 at 05:35:07.774324Z, then stale owner generation 80 route reassert is accepted 916.186 ms later and resurrects PREWARM_IN_FLIGHT; daemon remains non-terminal until 05:35:11.770851Z (~3.997 s after terminal). Current Fold7ContinuityCoordinator.ensureCoverRouteHeld() validates secondary state before launch but completion rechecks only destroyed/connection epoch, not active close-cycle/terminal state. Current DuoShellService.reassertCoverPanelGen4() checks owner equality then calls physical NORMAL and route activation without native-cover topology guard; prepare has the same class of terminal race. Proposed narrow fence: app-side active close-cycle + allowed-secondary-state checks before dispatch/result/retry; daemon-side coverLeaseTopology().nativeCover guard before physical power and again after physical wake/before route activation, calling markNativeCover/no-op when terminal. Do NOT gate all reasserts on exact controller generation because valid secondary-state transitions increment generation within one close-cycle. Deterministic model reproduces current race and passes 5/5 fence cases including legitimate same-cycle reassert. 120Hz untouched; semantic panel authority remains cadence-independent. R&D only; physical Fold7 validation required.
